facts.business: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Ltd. is an integrated provider of rail and infrastructure solutions, spanning freight cars, component systems, railway castings, and rail infrastructure solutions.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Vision 2030 roadmap seeks to build a more diversified, technology driven and resilient business with improved margin stability and profitability.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to geopolitical situation, trade uncertainties, supply chain disruption, escalation of costs and other macro level risks; provision for contingencies created by charge to free reserves not routed through profit and loss account.
